family_switch.interpretation: Numerical change includes post-calibrator-family selection. Missingness/acquisition status can itself be informative; this is not proof of no information or leakage.

prior_mass.interpretation: The documented regularizer depends on count of distinct raw scores. This is not a failure of PAV; do not replace evaluated banks retrospectively.

input_validation_boundary.scope: direct helper call only; production manifest validates valid target/cutoff and process_components rejects reversed interval. No current split contamination demonstrated.
